body:
## Goal
Importing the package yields a router with the store's routes registered.

## Files touched
- src/example/__init__.py
- tests/test_smoke.py

## Details
In src/example/__init__.py, build the Store and register its three routes on the router, exposing them as example.app. Extend tests/test_smoke.py to assert the three routes dispatch. This is the only ticket allowed to edit both files after their owners are done, which is why it is blocked by both.

## Acceptance criteria
pytest -q tests/test_smoke.py

## Blocked-by
#9003
#9004
title: Wire the store into the router at startup
